answer_1.quote: We conduct experiments on three datasets encompassing question answering (including knowledge base question answering-KBQA-and open-ended QA) and machine translation tasks.
answer_1.outputs: Generated answers for question answering and translations for machine translation

answer_2.quote: For WebQSP, we use precision, recall, and F1 scores. For MS MARCO, we employ BERTScore, using deberta-xlarge-mnli model to ensure optimal performance... referred to as BERT-F1. For MAC, we employ the Crosslingual Optimized Metric for Evaluation of Translation (COMET)... For repetition evaluation, we report the repetition ratio (RR). We also report the RAP scores...

answer_3.quote: To address this, we propose an LLM-based evaluation method where an LLM extracts and maps answer-items (entities) from the generated answer to the ground-truth entities.
